semantic_basis.note: Pages 10-11 use device-oriented wording inside ServiceStatus prose, including descriptions of device state where the operation and surrounding identifiers refer to service status.
Exact Common V2.2 defines ServiceIdentificationWithStateStructure as ServiceIdentification plus ServiceState and contains no DeviceState member in that structure.
The selected service XSD uses ServiceIdentificationWithStateList for GetServiceStatusResponseData, consistently routing this operation to service-state rather than device-state semantics.
The exact operation naming plus Common V2.2 structure rejects an alternate device-oriented ServiceStatus interpretation; the inconsistent prose is a documentation copy/paste defect.

de.title: SystemMonitoringService V2.2: Device/Service-Verwechslung in ServiceStatus-Texten
de.short: Die PDF beschreibt in ServiceStatus-Abschnitten teilweise Gerätezustände, obwohl die offizielle Struktur ServiceIdentification plus ServiceState verwendet.
de.long: Auf den Seiten 10 und 11 verwendet die SystemMonitoringService-V2.2-PDF in den ServiceStatus-Beschreibungen teilweise Geräte-Terminologie. Die exakte Common-V2.2-XSD definiert ServiceIdentificationWithStateStructure dagegen eindeutig mit ServiceIdentification und ServiceState; die Service-XSD verwendet diese Struktur für GetServiceStatusResponseData. Damit ist die Device-Wortwahl ein semantischer Copy/Paste-Fehler der Dokumentation und keine alternative ausführbare Semantik.
de.recommendation: Für die technische Interpretation die exakte ServiceStatus-/ServiceState-Struktur der ausgewählten XSD verwenden. Den PDF-Wortlaut als bekannten Dokumentationsfehler kennzeichnen, aber keine Runtime-Regel oder automatische Umdeutung erzeugen.

en.title: SystemMonitoringService V2.2: device/service mix-up in ServiceStatus prose
en.short: The PDF sometimes describes device state in ServiceStatus sections although the official structure uses ServiceIdentification plus ServiceState.
en.long: On pages 10 and 11, the SystemMonitoringService V2.2 PDF uses device-oriented terminology in ServiceStatus descriptions. Exact Common V2.2 instead defines ServiceIdentificationWithStateStructure with ServiceIdentification and ServiceState, and the service XSD uses that structure for GetServiceStatusResponseData. The device wording is therefore a semantic documentation copy/paste defect rather than an alternative executable meaning.
en.recommendation: Use the exact ServiceStatus/ServiceState structure from the selected XSD for technical interpretation. Flag the PDF wording as a known documentation defect, but do not create a runtime rule or automatic reinterpretation.
